summary: DoorDash filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 disclosing completion of its reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective September 18, 2026 at 12:02 a.m. Pacific, following filings with both secretaries of state on September 17, 2026. Each Delaware Class A and Class B share automatically converted one-for-one into Nevada shares of identical par value $0.00001, with no certificate exchange required. New Nevada articles and bylaws govern, plus fresh indemnification agreements with officers and directors. No change to business, management, assets or liabilities; a governance redomiciliation, not a special situation, with litigation-risk/statutory-ambiguity the only watch item.
